rt:model.rt:sub:
Sub GetNodeStatus() Dim WS_ID As String Dim NStatus As UShort Dim NDStatus As UShort Dim NodeNet As UShort Dim IP1 As String Dim IP2 As String Dim CPU_load As UShort Dim t_ID As String Dim t_Status As String Dim t_Net_1 As String Dim t_Net_2 As String Dim t_CPU As String Dim rect_ID As String Dim rect_Status As String Dim rect_Net_1 As String Dim rect_Net_2 As String Dim rect_CPU As String Dim rect_DataOK As String Dim rect_Repl_S As String Dim rect_Repl_R As String Dim rect_Vis As String Dim R As String Dim W As String Dim G As String
W = Col_Ar(7) R = Col_Ar(1) G = Col_Ar(2)
If NdID == Nothing Then t_ID = "" rect_ID = Col_Ar(7) t_Status = "" rect_Status = Col_Ar(7) t_Net_1 = "" t_Net_2 = "" rect_Net_1 = Col_Ar(7) rect_Net_2 = Col_Ar(7) rect_CPU = Col_Ar(7) rect_DataOK = Col_Ar(7) rect_Repl_S = Col_Ar(7) rect_Repl_R = Col_Ar(7) rect_Vis = Col_Ar(7)
Else NdID.Refresh() WS_ID = PLStrCut(NdID.NodeName, 20) NStatus = NdID.NodeStatus IP1 = NdID.IPAddress IP2 = NdID.IPAddress_2 If NdID.NodeId != RTA.LocalNode.NodeId Then NodeNet = NdID.NetMask Else NodeNet = LocalNetMask End If CPU_load = NdID.CPULoad
t_ID = NdID.NodeName If Active Then rect_ID = Col_Ar(14) Else rect_ID = Col_Ar(8) End If t_Status = ENodeState(NStatus, False) rect_Status = NodStatColor(NStatus) t_Net_1 = IP1 t_Net_2 = IP2 If NStatus < 4 Then rect_Net_1 = Col_Ar(8) rect_Net_2 = Col_Ar(8) rect_CPU = Col_Ar(8) rect_DataOK = Col_Ar(8) rect_Repl_S = Col_Ar(8) rect_Repl_R = Col_Ar(8) rect_Vis = Col_Ar(8) Else ' If (IP1 == "") || ((LocalNetMask & 1) == 0) Then ' rect_Net_1 = Col_Ar(8) ' Else ' rect_Net_1 = Col_Ar((NodeNet & 1) + 1) ' End If ' If (IP2 == "") || ((LocalNetMask & 2) == 0) Then ' rect_Net_2 = Col_Ar(8) ' Else ' rect_Net_2 = Col_Ar((NodeNet & 2) / 2 + 1) ' End If
' анализ сети
If (NdID.NetMask & 8) != 0 Then ' сеть 2 есть rect_Net_2 = Col_Ar(2) ' зеленый Else ' сети 1 нет rect_Net_2 = Col_Ar(1) ' красный
End If
If (NdID.NetMask & 4) != 0 Then ' сеть 1 есть rect_Net_1 = Col_Ar(2) ' зеленый Else ' сети 2 нет rect_Net_1 = Col_Ar(1) ' красный
End If
t_CPU = CStr(CPU_load) If CPU_load > 90 Then rect_CPU = Col_Ar(1) ElseIf CPU_load > 75 Then rect_CPU = Col_Ar(3) Else rect_CPU = Col_Ar(2) End If NDStatus = NdID.DataStatus If (NDStatus & RTDATA_STAT_OK) > 0 Then rect_DataOK = Col_Ar(2) Else rect_DataOK = Col_Ar(1) End If
'задачи сделаны через флаги If (NDStatus & RTDATA_STAT_FEATURE_7_OK) Then rect_Repl_S = Col_Ar(2) Else rect_Repl_S = Col_Ar(1) End If If (NDStatus & RTDATA_STAT_FEATURE_8_OK) Then rect_Repl_R = Col_Ar(2) Else rect_Repl_R = Col_Ar(1) End If If (NDStatus & RTDATA_STAT_FEATURE_4_OK) Then rect_Vis = Col_Ar(2) Else rect_Vis = Col_Ar(1) End If End If End If
If rect_Status == W Then body.fill = Col_Ar(7) Else If rect_Status == R Then body.fill = Col_Ar(1) Else If ((rect_Net_1 == G) & (rect_Net_2 == G) & (rect_CPU == G) & (rect_DataOK == G) & (rect_Repl_S == G) & (rect_Repl_R == G) & (rect_Vis == G) ) Then body.fill = Col_Ar(2) Else body.fill = Col_Ar(3) End If End If End If
End Sub

Sub Alarm_IBP()
If (IBP_XQ01 == Nothing) || (IBP_XQ02 == Nothing) || (IBP_XQ03 == Nothing) || (IBP_XQ04 == Nothing) || (IBP_XQ05 == Nothing) || (IBP_XQ06 == Nothing) || (IBP_XQ07 == Nothing) || (IBP_XQ08 == Nothing) || (IBP_XQ09 == Nothing) || (IBP_ZV02 == Nothing) || (IBP_ZV03 == Nothing) || (IBP_ZV04 == Nothing) Then Diag_IBP.fill = "Col_Grey1" Else
If (IBP_XQ01.Quality != 3) && (IBP_XQ02.Quality != 3) && (IBP_XQ03.Quality != 3) && (IBP_XQ04.Quality != 3) && (IBP_XQ05.Quality != 3) && (IBP_XQ06.Quality != 3) && (IBP_XQ07.Quality != 3) && (IBP_XQ08.Quality != 3) && (IBP_XQ09.Quality != 3) && (IBP_ZV02.Quality != 3) && (IBP_ZV03.Quality != 3) && (IBP_ZV04.Quality != 3) Then Diag_IBP.fill = "Col_Grey1" Else
If (IBP_XQ01.AlarmLevel == 3) || (IBP_XQ02.AlarmLevel == 3) || (IBP_XQ03.AlarmLevel == 3) || (IBP_XQ04.AlarmLevel == 3) || (IBP_XQ05.AlarmLevel == 3) || (IBP_XQ06.AlarmLevel == 3) || (IBP_XQ07.AlarmLevel == 3) || (IBP_XQ08.AlarmLevel == 3) || (IBP_XQ09.AlarmLevel == 3) || (IBP_ZV02.Value == 1) || (IBP_ZV02.Value == 2) || (IBP_ZV02.Value == 4) || (IBP_ZV02.Value == 5) || (IBP_ZV02.Value == 6) || (IBP_ZV02.Value == 7) || (IBP_ZV03.Value == 1) || (IBP_ZV04.Value == 5) Then Diag_IBP.fill = "Col_Red" ElseIf (IBP_XQ01.AlarmLevel == 2) || (IBP_XQ02.AlarmLevel == 2) || (IBP_XQ03.AlarmLevel == 2) || (IBP_XQ04.AlarmLevel == 2) || (IBP_XQ05.AlarmLevel == 2) || (IBP_XQ06.AlarmLevel == 2) || (IBP_XQ07.AlarmLevel == 2) || (IBP_XQ08.AlarmLevel == 2) || (IBP_XQ09.AlarmLevel == 2) Then Diag_IBP.fill = "Col_Yellow" ElseIf ((IBP_XQ01.AlarmLevel == 0) && (IBP_XQ01.Quality == 3)) && ((IBP_XQ02.AlarmLevel == 0) && (IBP_XQ02.Quality == 3)) && ((IBP_XQ03.AlarmLevel == 0) && (IBP_XQ03.Quality == 3)) && ((IBP_XQ04.AlarmLevel == 0) && (IBP_XQ04.Quality == 3)) && ((IBP_XQ05.AlarmLevel == 0) && (IBP_XQ05.Quality == 3)) && ((IBP_XQ06.AlarmLevel == 0) && (IBP_XQ06.Quality == 3)) && ((IBP_XQ07.AlarmLevel == 0) && (IBP_XQ07.Quality == 3)) && ((IBP_XQ08.AlarmLevel == 0) && (IBP_XQ08.Quality == 3)) && ((IBP_XQ09.AlarmLevel == 0) && (IBP_XQ09.Quality == 3)) && (IBP_ZV02.Value == 3) && ((IBP_ZV03.Value == 0) && (IBP_ZV03.Quality == 3)) && ((IBP_ZV04.Value == 1) || (IBP_ZV04.Value == 2) || (IBP_ZV04.Value == 3) || (IBP_ZV04.Value == 4)) Then Diag_IBP.fill = "Col_Green" Else Diag_IBP.fill = "Col_Grey1" End If
End If
End If
End Sub

Sub Alarm_MKB()
If (MKB_ZV02 == Nothing) || (MKB_ZV03 == Nothing) || (MKB_ZV04 == Nothing) || (MKB_ZV05 == Nothing) || (MKB_ZV06 == Nothing) || (MKB_ZV07 == Nothing) || (MKB_ZV08 == Nothing) || (MKB_ZV09 == Nothing) || (MKB_ZV12 == Nothing) || (MKB_ZV14 == Nothing) || (MKB_ZV16 == Nothing) || (MKB_ZV17 == Nothing) || (MKB_XQ01 == Nothing) Then Diag_MKB.fill = "Col_Grey1" Else
If (MKB_ZV02.Quality != 3) && (MKB_ZV03.Quality != 3) && (MKB_ZV04.Quality != 3) && (MKB_ZV05.Quality != 3) && (MKB_ZV06.Quality != 3) && (MKB_ZV07.Quality != 3) && (MKB_ZV08.Quality != 3) && (MKB_ZV09.Quality != 3) && (MKB_ZV12.Quality != 3) && (MKB_ZV14.Quality != 3) && (MKB_ZV16.Quality != 3) && (MKB_ZV17.Quality != 3) && (MKB_XQ01.Quality != 3) Then Diag_MKB.fill = "Col_Grey1" Else
If (MKB_ZV02.Value = 1) || ((MKB_ZV03.Value >= 2) && (MKB_ZV03.Value =< 8)) || ((MKB_ZV04.Value >= 2) && (MKB_ZV04.Value =< 8)) || ((MKB_ZV05.Value >= 1) && (MKB_ZV05.Value =< 3)) || ((MKB_ZV06.Value >= 1) && (MKB_ZV06.Value =< 3)) || ((MKB_ZV07.Value >= 1) && (MKB_ZV07.Value =< 3)) || ((MKB_ZV08.Value >= 1) && (MKB_ZV08.Value =< 3)) || ((MKB_ZV09.Value >= 1) && (MKB_ZV09.Value =< 3)) || ((MKB_ZV16.Quality = 3) && (MKB_ZV16.Value = 0)) && ((MKB_ZV17.Quality = 3) && (MKB_ZV17.Value = 0)) || (MKB_XQ01.AlarmLevel = 3) Then Diag_MKB.fill = "Col_Red" ElseIf ((MKB_ZV05.Value >= 5) && (MKB_ZV05.Value =< 9)) || ((MKB_ZV06.Value >= 5) && (MKB_ZV06.Value =< 9)) || ((MKB_ZV07.Value >= 5) && (MKB_ZV07.Value =< 9)) || ((MKB_ZV08.Value >= 5) && (MKB_ZV08.Value =< 9)) || ((MKB_ZV09.Value >= 5) && (MKB_ZV09.Value =< 9)) || (MKB_ZV12.Value = 1) || (MKB_ZV14.Value = 1) || ((MKB_ZV16.Quality = 3) && (MKB_ZV16.Value = 0)) || ((MKB_ZV17.Quality = 3) && (MKB_ZV17.Value = 0)) || (MKB_XQ01.AlarmLevel = 3) || (MKB_XQ01.AlarmLevel = 2) Then Diag_MKB.fill = "Col_Yellow" ElseIf (MKB_ZV02.Value = 2) && (MKB_ZV03.Value = 1) && (MKB_ZV04.Value = 1) && (MKB_ZV05.Value = 4) && (MKB_ZV06.Value = 4) && (MKB_ZV07.Value = 4) && (MKB_ZV08.Value = 4) && (MKB_ZV09.Value = 4) && ((MKB_ZV12.Value = 0) && (MKB_ZV12.Quality = 3)) && ((MKB_ZV14.Value = 0) && (MKB_ZV14.Quality = 3)) && (MKB_ZV16.Value = 1) && (MKB_ZV17.Value = 1) && ((MKB_XQ01.AlarmLevel = 0) && (MKB_XQ01.Quality = 3)) Then Diag_MKB.fill = "Col_Green" Else Diag_MKB.fill = "Col_Grey1" End If
End If
End If
End Sub

Sub Alarm_TIME()
If (TIME_ZV01 == Nothing)||(TIME_XQ01 == Nothing) Then Diag_TIME.fill = "Col_Grey1" Else If (TIME_ZV01.Quality != 3) && (TIME_XQ01.Quality != 3) Then Diag_TIME.fill = "Col_Grey1" Else
If (TIME_ZV01.Value = 1) || (TIME_XQ01.AlarmLevel = 3) Then Diag_TIME.fill = "Col_Red" ElseIf (TIME_ZV01.Value = 2) || (TIME_XQ01.AlarmLevel = 2) Then Diag_TIME.fill = "Col_Yellow" ElseIf ((TIME_ZV01.Value = 0) && (TIME_ZV01.Quality = 3)) && ((TIME_XQ01.AlarmLevel = 0) && (TIME_XQ01.Quality = 3)) Then Diag_TIME.fill = "Col_Green" Else Diag_TIME.fill = "Col_Grey1" End If
End If End If End Sub

rect.rt:event: Open_Win_Uni(False, "diag_WS" + KKS, "Состояние рабочей станции", "wd_diag_WS", KKS + "|" + title_base + "|0")
